SQL_DOC.V_SQL:
SELECT * FROM( SELECT 'HANL' AS BUYER , 'PO' AS DOC_TYPE , NVL(PO_REQ_NO,' ') AS KEY_NO , NVL(GD_CD_MRO,' ') AS KEY_SEQ , NVL(GD_CD,' ') AS DATA01 , NVL(REQ_QTY, 0) AS DATA02 , NVL(REQ_DATE,' ') AS DATA03 , NVL(OK_QTY, 0) AS DATA04 , NVL(APPSTATUS,' ') || '^' || NVL(SEPARATE_YN,' ') AS DATA05
FROM MRO_PO_REQ WHERE MRO_SEND = 'N'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'HANL' AS BUYER , 'INV' AS DOC_TYPE , NVL(PO_REQ_NO,' ') AS KEY_NO , NVL(GD_CD_MRO,' ') AS KEY_SEQ , NVL(GD_CD,' ') AS DATA01 , NVL(TO_NUMBER(IP_DT), 0) AS DATA02 , NVL(STATUS,' ') AS DATA03 , NVL(TO_NUMBER(IP_CNFM_DT), 0) AS DATA04 , NVL(APPSTATUS,' ') AS DATA05
FROM MRO_PO_IPGO WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND GR_NO IS NULL ) Z ORDER BY Z.DOC_TYPE, Z.BUYER, Z.KEY_NO, Z.KEY_SEQ
